description: This is a Flutter widget class defining the login screen UI and login logic for user authentication in the healthcare app.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Main widget class for the user login screen, offering UI and logic for authentication.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the login form, user input controllers, and login process.

methods.description: Disposes controllers when widget is removed from the tree.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen UI.
